description: This Java class represents a response to a 'ModifyConnection' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates the outcome of the command, including the connection ID and relevant headers, and provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: ModifyConnectionResponse
classes.description: A final class representing the response to a 'ModifyConnection' command, immutable, with functionalities for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and for serializing/deserializing JSON payloads.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyConnectionResponse with specified connectionId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ModifyConnectionResponse object from a JSON string or JSON object along with headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the response payload to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the connection ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as entity payload is not included in this response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if the other object is an instance of this class, used for equality.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on connection ID, headers, and superclass equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on class properties and superclass.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object including class name, superclass info, and connection ID.
